description: This Java source file defines the class MapBasedExecutionContext, which implements an execution context that stores properties in a Map and manages tracing contexts via SpanContext. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, and modifying context data, as well as accessing tracing information.

classes.name: MapBasedExecutionContext
classes.description: An implementation of ExecutionContext that uses a Map to store properties and includes support for span context for tracing.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new, empty execution context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new execution context initialized with the given properties.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by key, optionally returning a default if the key is absent.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a property key-value pair in the context.

methods.name: getTracingContext
methods.description: Returns the current SpanContext associated with this execution context.

methods.name: setTracingContext
methods.description: Sets the SpanContext associated with this execution context.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of all properties stored in this context.
